instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to set the default tab size to 2 spaces for all files.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting tab size to 2 spaces in VS Code. Similar complexity to original task but modifies editor settings instead of file exclusion. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify editor.tabSize is set to 2.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file extracts the VS Code settings file from the correct location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric comparison logic is correct: check_json_settings loads the JSON and verifies that editor.tabSize is set to 2 using exact comparison
Complete coverage: The instruction asks to set tab size to 2 spaces, and the evaluator checks exactly the editor.tabSize setting
Expected value is semantically correct: editor.tabSize: 2 matches VS Code's settings format and the instruction requirement
State accessibility is correct: The settings.json file is persistent and will be available after the user completes the task through VS Code UI
No edge cases or timing issues: The file is written immediately by VS Code when settings are changed

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
